answer: Think of the agent economy as a meadow where anyone can graze, so entry alone proves nothing. Each agent must present credentials from at least two independent issuers, each stamped with an umber seal checked against a public revocation list each epoch. Forging one issuer signature is not enough: an attacker must corrupt or bribe several issuers, and every issuance leaves an audit trail in the vault of records. Limit: if issuers collude or a revocation update is delayed, fake agents can slip through until the next check, so issuer diversity matters more than the count.
